rationale: The established Codex workflow owns implementation and executable validation.
An approved read-only Claude Code architecture review adds a distinct evidence artifact after the writer stops.

roles.purpose: Produce and validate the bounded implementation patch.
roles.stop_condition: Patch, test output, diff review, and residual risks are recorded.

roles.purpose: Review the stopped patch for architecture boundary regressions.
validation: Confirm reviewer made no repository edits
roles.stop_condition: Findings and unanswered questions are returned without modifying the patch.
